name: Shader Hero
tagline: A landing page with a dramatic, interactive shader hero that reacts to every move of the cursor.
youSay: /shader-hero Make a launch page for Nimbus, an AI note-taking app. Calm and premium, deep blue and mint.
whatYouGet: A landing page folder with a full-screen interactive shader hero and features, steps and CTA sections
7 tuned effects: liquid chrome, aurora, ink, particles, glass lens, dunes and plasma
Built-in care for speed and accessibility: pauses off-screen, still frame for reduced motion, CSS fallback
goodFit: Studios, portfolios and events that want a 'wow' first impression
notFor: Content-heavy sites where the hero must stay quiet
Pages that need to work in very old browsers
youBring: Optional: brand colours, fonts, a page you like
